title.ur: Compressor phase current detection circuit ki kharabi

meaning.en: Circuit measuring compressor phase currents is faulty.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke phase current naapne wala circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Detection circuit or compressor electrical issue
causes.ur: Detection circuit ya compressor mein electrical masla hai

causes.en: Damaged current-sensor wiring or a loose connector on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Outdoor board par current-sensor ki wiring ko nuksan pahuncha ya koi connector dhila hai

causes.en: Compressor winding fault giving unbalanced phase currents
causes.ur: Compressor winding kharab hone se phase currents barabar nahi rahte

solutions.en: Disconnect power and check the phase-current sensing wiring and connectors
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karke phase-current sensing wiring aur connectors check karein

solutions.en: A technician repairs the detection circuit or evaluates the compressor with a meter
solutions.ur: Technician detection circuit repair kare ya meter se compressor evaluate kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

notes.ur: Is code ki attribution multi-pk hai.

meaning.en: One phase to compressor missing during operation.
meaning.ur: Chalte waqt compressor tak pahunchne wali phases mein se koi ek phase ghaib ho gayi.

solutions.en: Isolate supply and check phases and contactor wiring with a meter before restart
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke restart se pehle meter se phases aur contactor wiring check karein

solutions.en: A technician inspects the compressor windings if the supply is correct
solutions.ur: Supply theek ho to technician compressor ki windings check kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

notes.ur: Is code ka source multi-pk hai.

title.ur: DC bus voltage drop ki hifazat

meaning.en: Significant drop on PN/DC bus detected (unstable supply or load fault).
meaning.ur: PN/DC bus par voltage ka bari girawa (unstable supply ya load ki kharabi).

causes.en: Heavy sag under compressor load / failing components
causes.ur: Compressor load par bhaari sag / components fail ho rahe hain

solutions.en: Power off and verify that the mains supply is stable before any measurement
solutions.ur: Power band karke kisi bhi measurement se pehle mains supply stable verify karein

solutions.en: A technician checks the DC bus under load and the failing components causing the sag
solutions.ur: Technician load par DC bus check kare aur woh kharab components jo sag la rahe hain

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

notes.en: Official greecomfort also groups U3 with voltage/power issues. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official (official describes U3 as DC bus voltage drop).
notes.ur: Official greecomfort U3 ko voltage/power issues ke saath group karta hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official (official describes U3 as DC bus voltage drop).

title.ur: Compressor ke ulat chalne ki hifazat

meaning.en: Compressor attempted to run backward (rotating-field/wiring issue).
meaning.ur: Compressor ulat direction mein chalne ki koshish kar raha tha (rotating field ya wiring ki kharabi).

solutions.en: Disconnect power and verify wiring and phase sequence before the next start
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karke agle start se pehle wiring aur phase sequence verify karein

solutions.en: A technician repairs the wiring or drive and rechecks the rotation direction
solutions.ur: Technician wiring ya drive repair kare aur rotation ki direction dobara check kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

notes.ur: Is code ki attribution multi-pk sources se hai.

title.ur: AC current detection circuit ki kharabi

meaning.en: Input AC current sensing path failed.
meaning.ur: Input AC current ka sensing path kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Loose connector or damaged harness to the current sensor
causes.ur: Current sensor ka connector dhila ya harness toota hua hai

causes.en: Detection circuit component failed on the outdoor board
causes.ur: Outdoor board par detection circuit ka component kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off and check the current-sensor connector and harness for damage
solutions.ur: Power band karke current-sensor connector aur harness ki damage check karein

solutions.en: A technician repairs or replaces the sensing circuit and verifies the readings
solutions.ur: Technician sensing circuit repair ya replace kare aur readings verify kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

notes.ur: Is code ka source multi-pk hai (per-code attribution).

meaning.en: Reversing valve failed to switch properly — unit stuck in one mode (cool-only or heat-only behavior).
meaning.ur: Reversing valve theek se switch nahi hua — unit ek hi mode mein atak gayi (sirf cooling ya sirf heating).

causes.ur: Reversing valve ya coil atka hua ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off, then a technician powers the reversing-valve coil to hear it click
solutions.ur: Power band karein, phir technician reversing-valve coil ko power dekar uski click aawaz sunaye

solutions.en: Replace the valve coil or the stuck reversing valve after checking wiring and the control signal
solutions.ur: Wiring aur control signal check karne ke baad valve coil ya atka hua reversing valve badlein

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

notes.en: Maqsood: room never reaches set temp in alternate mode. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + maqsood + r-pro.
notes.ur: Maqsood: alternate mode mein kamra set temperature tak pahunch hi nahi pata. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + maqsood + r-pro.

title.ur: Exhaust/discharge temperature sensor ka connector khul gaya

meaning.en: Discharge temperature sensor is unplugged or open-circuit.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature sensor ka plug nahi laga ya circuit khul ho gaya hai.

causes.ur: Sensor connector dhila ya toota hua hai

solutions.en: Disconnect power and reseat the discharge-temperature sensor connector
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karke discharge-temperature sensor ka connector dobara lagayein

solutions.en: If the connector and wiring are good, replace the sensor
solutions.ur: Connector aur wiring theek ho to sensor badlein

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)

title.ur: Zero-cross / zero-voltage detection ki kharabi (AC supply)

meaning.en: Outdoor board cannot detect AC zero-cross/zero-voltage reference.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board AC supply ka zero-cross/zero-voltage point detect hi nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: Power off and verify the outdoor supply before checking the board
solutions.ur: Power band karke board check se pehle outdoor supply verify karein

solutions.en: A technician inspects the zero-cross detection circuitry and repairs it or the board
solutions.ur: Technician zero-cross detection circuitry check kare aur woh ya board repair kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ official U3 note)
